company.name: Form Energy
company.shortDescription: Form Energy is an energy technology company that produces electric grids and accelerates the transition to clean energy.
company.description: Form Energy is an energy technology and manufacturing company that develops multi-day energy storage systems for electric grids. Its first commercial product is an iron-air battery system designed to store and discharge electricity for up to 100 hours. The company also develops Formware, grid modeling software for evaluating energy storage and power system designs.

productsAndServices.description: A grid-scale battery system that stores and discharges electricity for up to 100 hours using iron, air, water, and a non-flammable electrolyte.

productsAndServices.description: A technology-neutral grid modeling toolkit for evaluating power-system investments and operations using multi-year, hourly data and real-world weather variability.

aiResearchSummary.text: Form Energy is researching iron-air and metal-air electrochemical cells and bulk energy storage for the electric grid. Work such as “Electrode configurations for iron-air electrochemical systems,” “Additive for iron-air batteries,” “Low cost metal electrodes,” “Metal air electrochemical cell architecture,” and “Refuelable battery for the electric grid and method of using thereof” focuses on iron electrodes, gas diffusion electrodes, alkaline electrolytes, refuelable designs, and grid-scale battery system architectures.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series G round raised $750,000,000, or 32.36% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
caveats: Crunchbase reports 14 rounds but provides 10 detailed rows.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 4 disclosed grants total $294,000,000, representing 12.68% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,200,000,000 to $2,000,000,000, a 1.67x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 83 (-13 over 90 days) and market heat at 88 (+20).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
